name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 11 – Am 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 11d. Recalls, in the light of the Paradise Papers, that most oligarchs’ assets are hidden in European tax havens; underlines that independent journalists have estimated that Russian oligarchs’ assets hidden in tax havens represent at least USD 17.5 billion; deplores the fact that this lack of tax transparency prevents the EU from applying sanctions to oligarchs’ assets and thus applying real pressure on them, and in turn, Putin; calls for the EU to request that EU Member States, in particular EU tax havens, publish a registry of assets owned by Russian oligarchs, imposing penalties if they fail to do so;
